name: Denry Klin, Editor in Chief
oracle_text:
Denry Klin enters with your choice of a +1/+1, first strike, or vigilance counter on it.
Whenever a nontoken creature you control enters, if Denry Klin has counters on it, put the same number of each kind of counter on that creature.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a nontoken creature you control enters, if Denry Klin has counters on it, put the same number of each kind of counter on that creature.

needs.what: an op that, for every kind of counter on a source object (self), puts that many counters of the same kind on another object (the entering creature bound by the trigger), without removing them from the source -- any kind, keyword counters included
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters takes one named `counter` kind, so three add_counters reading counters_on self for +1/+1, first strike and vigilance would miss any other kind Denry later gains (proliferate onto -1/-1, shield, etc.); move_counters with all_kinds removes the counters from the source; double_counters only doubles counters on the same object
